rules.name: locked_registration
rules.cliff: registration is not locked before scoring or evaluation is not explicitly authorized

rules.name: endpoint_lineage
rules.cliff: checkpoint file hash, semantic tensor digest, seed, arm, or final-step identity differs from the lock

rules.name: partition_identity
rules.cliff: EVAL-D data, document, position-key, or cache hash differs from the readiness receipt

rules.name: document_quarantine
rules.cliff: any EVAL-D document overlaps training, DEV, prior evaluation, or EVAL-E

rules.name: option_b_cache_schema
rules.cliff: cache lacks the four-horizon student, 14B lattice, top-k probe, canonical-target, or document fields required by the locked evaluator

rules.name: read_once_lease
rules.cliff: read-once state is already spent, absent, non-atomic, or cannot be durably marked started

rules.name: no_optimizer_or_mutation
rules.cliff: an optimizer exists, a parameter requires gradients, or any endpoint tensor changes before versus after

rules.name: paired_schedule
rules.cliff: arm row order, anchor keys, document IDs, candidate lattice, or scorer implementation differs

rules.name: row_completeness
rules.cliff: a row is missing, duplicated, non-finite, or cannot reproduce the public aggregate within 2e-6

rules.name: single_scripted_verdict
rules.cliff: bootstrap seed, replicate count, document unit, thresholds, or scripted reading differs from the lock
